pairing.error_discovery: Could not discover Bluetooth devices. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled and the device is in pairing mode.
pairing.instructions_title: Put the fan in pairing mode
pairing.instructions_intro: The fan only shares its authentication code while it is in Bluetooth pairing mode. Without that code Homey can read the fan, but not control it.
pairing.instructions_step1: Make sure the fan has power.
pairing.instructions_step2: On the fan's touch panel, press the on/off symbol once.
pairing.instructions_step3: Then press and hold the light / air quality symbol for 8 seconds, until it starts flashing.
pairing.instructions_step4: While the symbol is flashing, press Next to search for the fan.

errors.connection_failed: Could not connect to the fan. Make sure it has power and is within Bluetooth range.
errors.write_failed: The fan did not accept the command. Try again, or run Repair on the device if it keeps happening.
errors.read_only: Homey can read this fan but not control it. Put the fan in pairing mode and run Repair on the device.
errors.not_authenticated: The fan is ignoring commands from Homey. Put the fan in pairing mode and run Repair on the device.
errors.ble_unavailable: Homey's Bluetooth scanning has stopped working - no nearby devices are visible at all, so this is not a range problem. Restarting Homey normally fixes it.
errors.rate_limited: The fan could not be reached several times in a row. Homey waits __seconds__ seconds before trying again.

repair.title: Repair fan
repair.intro: This reconnects the fan from scratch: it forces a fresh Bluetooth scan instead of trusting Homey's cached one, rebuilds the connection, and reads the authentication code again. Use it when the fan is stuck unavailable, or after you have put it into pairing mode.
repair.pairing_mode_title: To also enable control (Boost, modes, fan speed)
repair.pairing_mode_step1: Make sure the fan has power.
repair.pairing_mode_step2: On the fan's touch panel, press the on/off symbol once.
repair.pairing_mode_step3: Then press and hold the light / air quality symbol for 8 seconds, until it starts flashing.
repair.pairing_mode_note: The flashing symbol means Bluetooth pairing mode is active. The fan only hands out its authentication code while in this mode, and without that code it accepts readings but ignores every command. Start the repair while the symbol is flashing.
repair.progress_scan: Scanning for the fan (this can take up to a minute)…
repair.progress_auth: The fan does not accept Homey's authentication yet, reading its code again…
repair.result_auth_ok: Authentication code stored — control is enabled
repair.result_auth_missing: The fan still does not accept Homey's authentication. It was probably not in pairing mode, so Homey can read it but not control it. Follow the steps above and repair again while the symbol is flashing.
repair.result_failed_hint: The fan could not be reached. Check that it has power and is in range, then try again. If repeated attempts fail while other Bluetooth devices also stop working, Homey's Bluetooth may need a restart.
repair.error_no_status_characteristic: Connected, but the fan did not expose its status characteristic. Try the repair again.
